E0612

Wildcard imports (`use math.*`) are not supported

What

Wildcard imports (`use math.*`) are not supported

Why

The registered jet rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0612

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0612: tests/ui/module_wildcard.stderr.

Error [E0612]: wildcard imports are not supported
  --> tests/ui/module_wildcard.jet:7:10
    |
  7 | use math.*;
    |          ^
 Why: `use math.*` would hide where each name comes from
 Fix: list each item instead: `use math.[item, other]`
